annotations.grafana.app/message: Installed by the Grafana Asserts Plugin

targets.expr:
1000 * sum by (job,service, asserts_request_type) (rate({asserts_metric_latency="seconds_sum",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", accountID=""}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(sum by (job,service, asserts_request_type) (rate({asserts_metric_latency="count",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

targets.expr:
1000 * sum by (asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context) 
  (rate({asserts_metric_latency="seconds_sum",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",accountID="", job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(sum by (asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context) 
  (rate({asserts_metric_latency="count",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Avg Request Latency (ms)

targets.expr:
100 * sum by (job,service, asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context, asserts_error_type) (increase({asserts_metric_error="total",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service",  asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"}[5m]))
   / ignoring(asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context, asserts_error_type) group_left() 
 (sum by (job,service)(increase({asserts_metric_request="total",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context"}[5m])))

group by (alertname, asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context, asserts_error_type) (asserts:alerts{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",Service="$job", alertname=~"(ErrorRatioAnomaly|ErrorRatioBreach)", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"}) * 0.001

100 * avg_over_time((sum by (job,service, asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context, asserts_error_type) ({asserts_metric_error="gauge",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"}))[5m:])
   / ignoring(asserts_request_type, asserts_request_context, asserts_error_type) group_left() 
 (avg_over_time((sum by (job,service)({asserts_metric_request="gauge",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service",  asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context"}))[5m:]))

sum by(asserts_request_type, asserts_error_type) (rate({asserts_metric_error="total",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", instance=~"$instance", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"}[5m]) * 100 ) / ignoring(asserts_error_type) group_left() (sum by(asserts_request_type) (rate({asserts_metric_request="total",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context"}[5m]))) and (topk(10,sum by(asserts_request_type, asserts_error_type) (rate({asserts_metric_error="total",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"}[5m]) * 100 )))

sum by(asserts_request_type, asserts_error_type) ({asserts_metric_error="gauge",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service",  asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"} * 100 ) / ignoring(asserts_error_type) group_left() (sum by(asserts_request_type) ({asserts_metric_request="gauge",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context"})) and (topk(10,sum by(asserts_request_type, asserts_error_type) ({asserts_metric_error="gauge",namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job",service="$service", asserts_request_type=~"$request_type", asserts_request_context=~"$request_context", asserts_error_type=~"$error_type"} * 100 )))
